_comment: SYNTHETIC polarizability derivative tensors (d alpha / d Q) for the CO2 fixture. Phonopy does not produce these; a real workflow reads them from a LEPSILON finite-difference run (vasp_raman.py, phonopy-spectroscopy, ...). The PATTERN is exact: in the centrosymmetric D_inf_h point group only gerade modes have a nonzero polarizability derivative, and for a free molecule the librations do not change the polarizability either, so nu1 is the only Raman-active mode. The MAGNITUDES (0.7 perpendicular, 2.1 parallel, arbitrary units) are made up.
